the algebraic representation of the correlation functions in integrablespin chains is given by the following formulas: for the homogeneous chains, for the non-homogeneous chains, and for the quantum group invariants.

the algebraic representation of the correlation functions in the homogeneous XXZ chain can be obtained from the representation for the inhomogeneous case by taking the thermodynamic limit.

the algebraic representation of the correlation functions of the XXZ spin chain in terms of the eigenstates of its Hamiltonian.
the algebraic representation of the correlation functions in integrible spin chains.
the algebraic representation of the two-point functions in the XXZ chain.
